title: STAC Collection Specification
description: This object represents Collections in a SpatioTemporal Asset Catalog.

collection.title: STAC Collection
collection.description: These are the fields specific to a STAC Collection. All other fields are inherited from STAC Catalog.

stac_version.title: STAC version
stac_version.description: The STAC version the Collection implements.

stac_extensions.title: STAC extensions
stac_extensions.description: A list of extension identifiers the Collection implements.

id.title: Identifier
id.description: Identifier for the Collection that is unique across the provider.

title.title: Title
title.description: A short descriptive one-line title for the Collection.

description.title: Description
description.description: Detailed multi-line description to fully explain the Collection. CommonMark 0.29 syntax MAY be used for rich text representation.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: List of keywords describing the Collection.

license.title: Collection License Name
license.description: Collection's license(s), either a SPDX License identifier, `various` if multiple licenses apply or `proprietary` for all other cases.

name.title: Organization name
name.description: The name of the organization or the individual.

description.title: Organization description
description.description: Multi-line description to add further provider information such as processing details for processors and producers, hosting details for hosts or basic contact information. CommonMark 0.29 syntax MAY be used for rich text representation.

roles.title: Organization roles
roles.description: Roles of the provider. Any of `licensor`, `producer`, `processor` or `host`.

url.title: Organization homepage
url.description: Homepage on which the provider describes the dataset and publishes contact information.

providers.title: Providers
providers.description: A list of providers, which may include all organizations capturing or processing the data or the hosting provider. Providers should be listed in chronological order with the most recent provider being the last element of the list.

spatial.title: Spatial extent object

bbox.title: Spatial extents
bbox.description: Potential spatial extents covered by the Collection.

spatial.description: Potential spatial extents covered by the Collection.

temporal.title: Temporal extent object

interval.title: Temporal extents
interval.description: Potential temporal extents covered by the Collection.

temporal.description: Potential temporal extents covered by the Collection.

links.title: Links
links.description: A list of references to other documents.

href.title: Link reference
href.description: The actual link in the format of an URL. Relative and absolute links are both allowed.

rel.title: Link relation type
rel.description: Relationship between the current document and the linked document.

type.title: Link type
type.description: Media type of the referenced entity.

title.title: Link title
title.description: A human readable title to be used in rendered displays of the link.

items.description: For each field only the original data type of the property can occur (except for arrays), but we can't validate that in JSON Schema yet. See the sumamry description in the STAC specification for details.

summaries.title: Summaries
summaries.description: A map of property summaries, either a set of values, a range of values or a JSON Schema.
